segments.text: A pregnant patient at 35 weeks is brought in after two generalized tonic-clonic seizures. Platelets are 74 ×10⁹/L, AST 168 U/L, ALT 151 U/L, creatinine 127 µmol/L, and glucose 5.8 mmol/L. CT head shows no hemorrhage or mass. Fetal monitoring reveals recurrent late decelerations with a baseline of 160/min. There is no history of epilepsy or recent head trauma.

segments.text: A child has had persistent fever to 40.1°C for six days despite acetaminophen. Symptoms and peak flow improve markedly after inhaled bronchodilator and systemic corticosteroid.

segments.text: Pain is initially described as central chest and upper abdominal discomfort with sweating and nausea, prompting cardiac evaluation. Temperature is 37.7 °C, heart rate 112/min, blood pressure 126/74 mmHg, and oxygen saturation 98% on room air. ECG shows sinus tachycardia without ischemic changes, and high-sensitivity troponin-I is 4 ng/L. The pain later localizes sharply to the right lower quadrant, where there is guarding and rebound tenderness. White-cell count is 13.8 ×10⁹/L, C-reactive protein 49 mg/L, and lipase is normal. CT abdomen shows a 10-mm inflamed appendix without abscess or perforation.

Ultrasound demonstrates bilateral hydronephrosis, a distended bladder, and a smooth enlarged prostate. After catheterization, urine output is brisk and edema begins to improve.

segments.text: Progressive urgency, weak stream, and nocturia have been present for nine months, with increasing leakage before reaching the toilet. Today there is mild lower abdominal pressure but no dysuria, fever, back pain, or rigors. Temperature is 36.9°C, blood pressure 145/80 mmHg, heart rate 78/min, and oxygen saturation 98% on room air. The abdomen is non-peritonitic, and the prostate feels symmetrically enlarged without nodules. Urinalysis shows trace blood, no leukocytes, and no nitrite. Creatinine is 96 µmol/L. Bladder ultrasonography demonstrates 510 mL residual volume after voiding, without stones or hydronephrosis. Symptoms improve substantially after catheter drainage.
